'''vader12 LU(V) that kills the death star 1.1''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[vader12]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]] (inferred from the title)

== Introduction ==

yep you heard what i said, LU(V) blows up the death star. would appreciate comments from ICEBREATH and CAM. PLACED 2nd in virginia states, only lost by 1 in final confrontation against black sun

The deck page itself was not captured by the Wayback Machine, so only the listing-page entry (title, author, date and blurb) survives; the card list is lost.


== Notes ==

* Listing-only entry: the GPN listing page 3 records this deck, but the deck page itself was never captured by the Wayback Machine (checked 11 October 2026), so the card list is lost. The side is inferred from the published title.
